summary: At launch a job may ask for credentials, Prompt on Launch fields, Ask passwords, a survey and extra variables; relaunches reapply the user's prompts, tabs must be filled in order, and the browser goes to the job status page; relaunch can target all or failed hosts.
questions: What information can a job template ask for at launch?
Does relaunching a job reuse my prompted values?
Why do I have to re-enter values in the launch prompt?
How do I relaunch only on failed hosts?
